translations.title: Albendazole 400 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to treat infection with roundworm, pinworm, hookworm, whipworm, American hookworm and threadworm, including mixed infections.
translations.usage: For roundworm, hookworm, whipworm and hookworm infection, adults and children 24 months or older take one tablet (400 mg) once. For pinworm, take one tablet and then one more tablet 7 days later to prevent reinfection. If threadworm occurs together with another parasite (tapeworm) as a severe infection, take one tablet (400 mg) once a day for 3 days. If the tablet is hard to swallow, you may chew it or take it with a small amount of water.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, or for children under 2. Do not take it together with theophylline, cimetidine, praziquantel, dexamethasone, ritonavir, phenytoin, carbamazepine or phenobarbital. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have liver or kidney problems. Pinworm often spreads again within a family, so it is best to treat everyone together.

summaryTable.Who should be careful: Pregnancy and breastfeeding; do not give to children under 2
